donnees.resume_source: The purpose of this study is to compare the tolerability and comfort of 4 different prototype anesthesia-free tonometer tips with the standard tonometer tip in conjunction with anesthesia. The best-tolerated prototype anesthesia-free tonometer tip will be identified for further development for home tonometry.

eligibilite.criteres:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Presenting for a routine eye exam
* ≥ 18 years of age
* Able and willing to give consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of corneal scarring
* Active infection of the eye
* History of alternated corneal sensitivity
* History of corneal surgery
